# Codex 

  

GTD (2001) said clear; your head." PARA (2017) said  organize; your files." The Codex says & document; your life so both you AND your AI can run it together — and your great-grandchildren can inherit it." Your Codex is the first document your family passes down that was designed for both humans and artificial intelligence to read.

![](data:image/png;base64,)  

  

![](data:image/png;base64,)  

Is this a good structure? Yes. It's excellent. The numbering system (00-99) is permanent and extensible. Every student can use the same structure with different content. The paths are universal — every human has a self, a family/community, and economic activity. UI as control plane is the innovation that makes this AI-native. Consider renaming UI from &quotUnified; Intelligence" to &quotUnified; Infrastructure" or just keeping it as &quotThe; Brain" in teaching. &quotIntelligence;" sounds like it's about AI only, but it also holds security (11), development (10), research (12), and automation (09) — it's broader than AI.
